verdict.rationale: Grok documents a set of xAI-maintained built-in connectors that users connect once via OAuth (grok-docs-19, grok-docs-11), covering third-party services such as Gmail/Calendar, Google Drive, Microsoft Teams and Salesforce. Users can also add custom MCP connectors for any other tool (grok-docs-2, grok-docs-38). missing for 10: explicit evidence of a browsable in-product directory/catalog UI, a marketplace of apps published by third-party developers (all listed connectors are xAI-maintained), independent or hands-on corroboration of the add-connector flow.
